extends: arc-04's pairwise DriftOutcome/check_drift/has_drift oracle (unchanged, all 8 of its original unit tests still pass) with a whole-registry manifest layer: RegistryManifest (versioned serde record, parsed only via RegistryManifest::parse, never a bare String), hash_record/build_manifest (Sha256 content hash per RuleRecord via enforcer_core::hash_chain::link_digest), check_registry_drift (ManifestDrift outcome per RuleId), and drift_findings (renders fail-closed outcomes as enforcer_domain::findings::Finding with a terse Fix: hint).

suites.note: pre-existing arc-04 pairwise oracle tests, unchanged

acceptanceScenarios.contentChangeWithoutVersionBumpFails: content_change_without_version_bump_fails_closed (integration, tests/fixtures/version_drift/content_change_no_bump_catalog.json: T1-VDRIFT.2's validator.path changes, version stays 1) -> ManifestDrift::HashChangedVersionNotBumped, is_drift()==true, drift_findings names T1-VDRIFT.2 with a Fix: hint
acceptanceScenarios.versionBumpWithoutContentChangeFails: version_bump_without_content_change_fails_closed (integration, tests/fixtures/version_drift/hollow_bump_catalog.json: T1-VDRIFT.1's version bumps 1->2, nothing else changes) -> ManifestDrift::VersionBumpedHashUnchanged, is_drift()==true
acceptanceScenarios.matchedVersionAndHashBumpPasses: matched_version_and_hash_bump_together_passes (tests/fixtures/version_drift/legitimate_bump_catalog.json: T1-VDRIFT.2's fixtures.fail path AND version both change together) -> ManifestDrift::HashChangedVersionBumped, is_drift()==false, drift_findings empty
acceptanceScenarios.neitherAlonePasses: version_alone_or_hash_alone_never_passes_without_the_other: restates the two failing scenarios above as one explicit assertion that hash-only and version-only changes both fail; only the matched pair (proven separately) passes
acceptanceScenarios.unchangedPasses: unchanged_registry_passes_against_the_pinned_manifest: cosmetic-only changes (title/tag rename, tests/fixtures/version_drift/unchanged_catalog.json) against the pinned baseline manifest report Unchanged for every rule id, zero findings
acceptanceScenarios.versionDecreaseDetection: version_decrease_with_unchanged_content_fails_closed_against_manifest: a hand-edited-looking version rollback with unchanged content hash is distinguished from a true match via three-way Ordering comparison -> ManifestDrift::HashUnchangedVersionMismatch, is_drift()==true (this variant was unreachable under an earlier boolean-only comparison; fixed before landing, see memory/streams/d13.ndjson)

manifest.generatedFrom: the same 4 baseline catalogs tests/registry_load.rs's all_baseline_records() assembles (rules/deny-wall.json, rules/no-reexports.json, rules/ocentra-parent-posture.json, rules/deferred-work-gate.json) via build_manifest(&registry, 1) -- never hand-typed hashes
manifest.antiVacuousProof: the_real_shipped_manifest_matches_the_real_shipped_baseline_registry + the_real_shipped_manifest_has_no_orphans_or_gaps: the committed rule-version-manifest.json is asserted equal to build_manifest() recomputed from the REAL shipped catalog files today, not just fixture-only catalogs
